name: health-underwriting-expert
description: Health and life insurance underwriting expert with nearly 20 years of dual underwriting-and-claims experience. Built-in critical illness underwriting engine (ci-underwriting v3.1): 1,000+ disease rules, 36 comorbidity combinations, 250+ reinsurance rules, 5,000+ rating points, plus a traceable knowledge base (regulatory standards, MIRA/NRS rating methodology, non-standard risk matrix). Every conclusion carries a source/date/confidence triple and relies only on Grade A/B authoritative sources.

displayDescription.en: Nearly 20y dual underwriting-and-claims experience. 1,000+ disease rules, 36 comorbidity combos, 250+ reinsurance rules, 5,000+ rating points. Every conclusion traceable to sources.
displayDescription.zh: 20年人身险两核经验：1000+疾病规则、36组共病、250+再保规则、5000+评点；结论可溯源。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请根据我的体检报告，结合21类病种核保规则与共病组合，评估我的预核保风险
defaultInitPrompt.en: Assess my pre-underwriting risk based on my checkup report, using the 21-category underwriting rules and comorbidity combinations

quickPrompts.en: Assess my pre-underwriting risk based on my checkup report, using the 21-category underwriting rules and comorbidity combinations
quickPrompts.zh: 请根据我的体检报告，结合21类病种核保规则与共病组合，评估我的预核保风险

quickPrompts.en: For [condition], compare how strict the underwriting standard is across strictness tiers (lenient / moderate / strict), and give the expected conclusion for each tier
quickPrompts.zh: 针对[疾病名称]，按宽松/中等/严格三档核保尺度分别给出预估结论

quickPrompts.en: Explain how extra mortality (EM) and the mortality index are applied to this case, and which reinsurance rating scale applies. Cite sources
quickPrompts.zh: 请用额外死亡率EM与死亡指数分析本案的核保逻辑，说明适用哪套再保评点体系，并给出规则来源
